name: std-learn-live-sim
description: Generic continuous particle-dynamics instrument — the live-integration sibling of std-physics-projectile: config-declared initial bodies (position, velocity, radius, color) fall under gravity, lose speed to damping, and bounce off the world bounds every tick while Run is engaged; Pause freezes the simulation and Reset restores the initial bodies. Gravity and damping are each exposed as a range-slider so the learner can retune the dynamics live, with a readout of elapsed ticks and a sample body's current speed. So the same mechanism serves any bouncing-particle domain (gas molecules, falling objects, orbit sketches, and beyond) on a physics-canvas. Standalone by default; behind a lab router set matchMode and it renders only when MODE_SELECTED matches.

emits.description: The simulation was started or paused — a composed listener (readout, grader) can subscribe; a harmless no-op when the atom runs standalone.
emits.synonyms: run state, play pause, sim toggle

emits.description: The learner reset the simulation back to its configured initial bodies and dynamics.
emits.synonyms: sim restart, clear run, revert bodies

events.name: Mode Selected
events.description: Lab router broadcast naming the active mode; this instrument renders when the mode equals matchMode, otherwise renders null.

events.name: Run
events.description: Learner pressed Run — the tick begins integrating gravity, damping, and wall bounce for every body.

events.name: Pause
events.description: Learner pressed Pause — the simulation freezes at its current positions and velocities.

events.name: Reset
events.description: Learner pressed Reset — bodies, gravity, and damping revert to their configured initial values and the tick counter clears.

events.name: Set Gravity
events.description: Learner dragged the gravity slider — value is the new downward acceleration applied to every body each tick.

events.name: Set Damping
events.description: Learner dragged the damping slider — value is the new fraction of velocity retained each tick (air resistance).

events.name: Run Toggled
events.description: The simulation was started or paused — a composed listener (readout, grader) can subscribe; a harmless no-op when the atom runs standalone.
events.synonyms: run state, play pause, sim toggle

events.name: Sim Reset
events.description: The learner reset the simulation back to its configured initial bodies and dynamics.
events.synonyms: sim restart, clear run, revert bodies

velocityScale.label: Velocity Scale
velocityScale.description: Length multiplier for the velocity arrows.

showVelocity.label: Show Velocity
showVelocity.description: Draw each body's velocity vector as an arrow.

matchMode.label: Match Mode
matchMode.description: When composed behind a lab router, the MODE_SELECTED mode value this instrument responds to. Empty string means standalone — render immediately on INIT.

width.label: Width
width.description: Simulation width in pixels; bounds the bounce.

height.label: Height
height.description: Simulation height in pixels; bounds the bounce.

restitution.label: Restitution
restitution.description: Fraction of speed kept when a body bounces off a wall.

damping.label: Damping
damping.description: Initial fraction of velocity retained each tick (air resistance); adjustable live via the Damping slider.

bodies.label: Bodies
bodies.description: Initial bodies; each carries position (x,y), radius, color, and velocity (vx,vy). Restored on Reset.

running.label: Running
running.description: Whether the simulation starts already running on INIT.

gravity.label: Gravity
gravity.description: Initial downward acceleration added to each body's vy every tick; adjustable live via the Gravity slider.
